_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.defaultConstraints: UNIQUE REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: UNIQUE REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NOT NULL, "listing_date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_bars" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "open" TEXT NOT NULL, "high" TEXT NOT NULL, "low" TEXT NOT NULL, "close" TEXT NOT NULL, "volume" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "as_of" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "market_open" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("market_open" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fx_rates" ("base" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("base", "quote", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "livret_rates" ("valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "annual_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("valid_from"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "livret_ceilings" ("valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("valid_from"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_sync" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "adjusted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_holidays" ("exchange" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exchange", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_early_closes" ("exchange" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "close_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "close_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exchange", "date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_years" ("exchange" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exchange", "year"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_packs" ("island_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "checked_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("island_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "sim_date" TEXT NULL, "difficulty" TEXT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "breached_stops" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "companion_state" TEXT NULL, "stop_reasons" TEXT NULL, "reached_today" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reached_today" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_ledger" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, "quantity_micros" INTEGER NULL, "limit_price" TEXT NULL, "stop_price" TEXT NULL, "price_currency" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((amount_cents IS NULL) != (quantity_micros IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fills" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fx_rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "fees_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallet_values" ("wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "flow_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("wallet_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dca_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dca_simulations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sim_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "drop_reaction" TEXT NOT NULL, "knowledge" TEXT NOT NULL, "savings" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekly_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_all" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_all" IN (0, 1)), "language" TEXT NULL, "live_starting_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_progress" ("node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_answer" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("node_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "glossary_state" ("term_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "discovered_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "quiz_passed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("quiz_passed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("term_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companion_log" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fired_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL, "dismissed_at" TEXT NULL);
